name: GitHub profile README
tagline: The README that GitHub shows at the top of the HelloWorldIE profile page
summary: The special repo whose README GitHub shows on the HelloWorldIE profile. It still holds GitHub's starter text: a short greeting, with the suggested profile lines left commented out. Unchanged since it was created in March 2024.
features: Edit README.md to change what visitors see at the top of the HelloWorldIE profile
